note: City of Montrose campground in Pioneer Park, next to the community pool, in two parts: rows beside the pool and a south loop by the softball field. The ten full-hookup sites are held for seasonal campers; nightly sites have water and electric or electric only. A walking path circles the pool area and follows the East Fork of the Vermillion River. --Claude
